risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure, including revenue, earnings, cash flow, cost savings, and identified operating pressures. Risk tone is mixed: weaker sales, currency effects, demand and pricing pressure, environmental liabilities, and restructuring costs are offset by improved operating cash flow, cost savings, and growth in selected businesses. Repeated forward-looking disclaimers, extensive adjusted metrics, and allocation-based business-unit reporting may complicate comparability and risk assessment.
